 Funeral announced for Prattville officer killed in off-duty crash 
 A Prattville police officer died in an off-duty crash on Monday, according to the police department. By WSFA 12 News Staff Published : Oct. 27, 2026 at 10:02 AM CDT | Updated : 15 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google AUTAUGA COUNTY, Ala. ( WSFA ) - A Prattville police officer died in an off-duty crash on Monday, according to the police department.
 Cpl. Dakota Lee Davis of the Prattville Police Department died from injuries he sustained in a crash on Highway 31 at the Interstate 65 Pine Level exit.
 “The loss of CPL. Davis is devastating not only to the Prattville Police Department but the City of Prattville and he will be missed by all. We ask that you keep his wife, his family, and the PPD in your thoughts and prayers. We also ask for prayers for the first responders at the scene of the accident and the family of the vehicle involved.”
 Prattville Police Chief Mark Thompson Prattville Fire Chief Josh Bingham remembered Davis as a hard worker and great officer. He said those who want to honor Davis should do something nice for someone. 
 Law enforcement held a procession Tuesday morning as Davis’ body was transported from Montgomery to Millbrook.
 The Prattville Police Department announced that the funeral service for CPL. Davis will be held Saturday, Oct. 31 at Centerpoint Fellowship Church at 1200 McQueen Smith Rd.
 The viewing will be held from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. followed by the funeral service at at 11:00 a.m. Anyone who would like to pay their respects to CPL. Davis and his to the community are welcome to attend, according to PPD. 
 PPD also said that CPL. Davis was a very much-loved member of our Department and he will surely be missed.
 The crash is still being investigated by the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency, and additional details have not been released at this time.
